name: codegraph
description: A live semantic knowledge graph of your codebase, beside your editor.

commands.title: codegraph: Diff Against Git Ref (HEAD, branch, tag)
codegraph: Copy MCP Config (connect your AI agent)
codegraph: Index Repository (live progress on the board)

codegraph.languages.typescript.description: Include TypeScript / JavaScript files in the graph.

codegraph.languages.python.description: Include Python files in the graph (accurate edges via Pyright, no Python runtime needed).

codegraph.exclude.description: Extra directory names to skip when scanning the workspace (in addition to node_modules, .git, dist, .venv, etc.).

codegraph.telemetry.description: codegraph collects no telemetry. This setting is off and reserved.

scripts.build:explorer: npm --prefix frontend run build && node esbuild.js
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:boundaries && npm run test && npm run build

comment:deps: Only packages the SHIPPED node processes require() un-bundled belong here — the extension host + MCP server externalize @vscode/tree-sitter-wasm, ts-morph, vscode-jsonrpc and require.resolve pyright's langserver; @modelcontextprotocol/sdk carries ajv (bundled MCP server needs it) + zod. Everything else (mermaid/sigma/graphology) is esbuild-bundled into dist/ + media/, so it is a BUILD-TIME devDependency and must NOT ship in the .vsix.
